mapper.insert: INSERT INTO presets(id, name, status, note, tags, image_url, sort_order, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}, #{status}, #{note}, CAST(#{tags} AS jsonb), #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
